## Goal
When you finish, `apps/mobile` is an Expo SDK 57 / React Native 0.86 application using expo-router, named `mobile` in the workspace, that boots to a placeholder screen, exports cleanly for Android and passes `expo-doctor`. It carries the whole project configuration the later mobile steps build on: `app.config.ts` (Anacast identity, env-driven `googleServicesFile` and EAS project id, plugins), `eas.json` (three build profiles), monorepo Metro config, Babel, TypeScript and ESLint wiring, the theme token file, the Supabase client built from `@church/supabase-client`'s `createMobileClient` with the Expo adapters injected, the TanStack Query client persisted through `expo-sqlite/kv-store`, and a root layout with all providers. Every route file of PLAN §9 exists as a typed placeholder so `expo-router`'s typed routes compile; the real screens arrive in 4.1b (auth, org gate), 4.2a/4.2b (feed, sermons) and 4.3 (push, More tab, notification settings). Nothing here needs a hosted Supabase project or an Expo account; the founder's EAS/Firebase work is step 4.5.

## Goal
When you finish, the Expo app from 4.1a has a complete sign-in flow and a tenancy gate. A person opens the app, enters the email their church has on file, receives a 6-digit code (the founder edits the Supabase Magic Link template to include `{{ .Token }}` in step 2.4 — DESIGN §5: "otherwise `signInWithOtp` sends a link"), types the code and lands in the tabs of their church. People with a password can use it instead. A tap on an invitation deep link `anacast://invite/<token>` (from the web invite page's "Open in app" button built in 2.1b) carries the token through sign-in and accepts the invitation with `accept_invitation`. Users with an account but no active membership see the `no-church` screen. Members of several churches get a switcher; the choice persists locally and in `profiles.last_org_id`. No feed, no players, no push yet (4.2a, 4.2b, 4.3).

## Inputs / prior state
- 4.1a produced `apps/mobile` (package `mobile`): `src/lib/supabase.ts` (`supabase: DbClient`, auto-refresh bound to AppState), `src/lib/query-client.ts` + `AppQueryProvider`, `src/lib/kv.ts` (`getKv/setKv/deleteKv` for `active_org_id`, `pending_invite_token`, `push_token`, `push_explainer_seen`), `src/lib/env.ts` (`publicEnv()`), `src/theme.ts`, `src/components/{Screen,LoadingState,ErrorState,EmptyState}.tsx`, placeholder route files for every screen, `app/(app)/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` (final), `app/index.tsx` (temporary redirect to sign-in). Scheme `anacast` is configured in `app.config.ts` and asserted equal to `APP_SCHEME`.
- `@church/domain` (1.6a/1.6b): `schemas/auth.ts` — `emailPasswordSchema` (password ≥ 8), `otpRequestSchema` (email), `otpVerifySchema` (email + 6-digit `token`), `passwordResetSchema`; `schemas/invitation.ts` — `acceptInvitationSchema { token }`, `invitationTokenSchema` (base64url, 43 chars), `acceptInvitationResultSchema { org_id, slug, membership_id, person_id }`; `schemas/context.ts` — `myContextSchema` = `{ is_super_admin, profile: { display_name, email, last_org_id }, orgs: [{ org_id, slug, name, status, membership_status, person_id, household_id, permissions }] }` and `contextOrgBySlug(ctx, slug)`; `urls.ts` — `APP_SCHEME`, `inviteDeepLink(token)` → `anacast://invite/<token>`, `inviteUrl(appUrl, token)`; `errors.ts` — `toDomainError(err)`, `DomainError` (`key`), `DOMAIN_ERROR_MESSAGES` (keys include `invitation_invalid`, `invitation_expired`, `invitation_email_mismatch`, `organization_suspended`, `minor_cannot_have_account`, `network`, `unknown`).
- `@church/db` (1.7a): `myContext(db)` → parsed `MyContext`; `acceptInvitation(db, { token })` → `{ org_id, slug, membership_id, person_id }`; `setLastOrg(db, userId, orgId)`; `getMyProfile(db, userId)`; `queryKeys.context()`; every helper takes the client first. Read `packages/db/src/rpc.ts` and `queries/*.ts` for exact names before importing — do not invent parallel helpers.
- `9999_init.sql` (1.3b): `accept_invitation(token)` verifies hash/expiry, requires the caller's `profiles.email` to equal the invitation email (`invitation_email_mismatch`), requires the org writable (`organization_suspended`), upserts the membership as `active`, creates a one-person household when no person is linked, merges for an existing member. `my_context()` returns memberships in every status except `disabled`; `membership_status` may be `pending` (Phase 2 join requests) — only `active` counts as access.
- Web 2.1b: `/invite/[token]` page shows "Open in app" → `inviteDeepLink(token)`; `/login` OTP tab uses `signInWithOtp({ email, options: { shouldCreateUser: false } })` and `/signup` exists on the web. Mobile has no signup screen (PLAN §9) — see Build 3 for how account creation is handled on mobile.

## Build
1. **Session provider** `src/features/auth/SessionProvider.tsx`: on mount `supabase.auth.getSession()`, then `onAuthStateChange((event, session) => …)`; expose `useSession()` → `{ session, userId, status: 'loading' | 'signed_out' | 'signed_in' }`. On `SIGNED_OUT` clear `active_org_id` from kv and call `queryClient.clear()` (the persisted cache must not leak one account's feed to the next). Mount it inside `app/_layout.tsx` under `AppQueryProvider`. Keep the splash screen up until `status !== 'loading'`.
2. **Context query** `src/features/auth/useMyContext.ts`: `useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.context(), queryFn: () => myContext(supabase), enabled: status === 'signed_in', staleTime: 60_000 })`; export `activeOrgs(ctx)` = orgs with `membership_status === 'active'` (pure, tested); `refreshContext()` = `invalidateQueries(queryKeys.context())`.
3. **`(auth)/sign-in`** (`app/(auth)/sign-in.tsx`, `src/features/auth/SignInForm.tsx`, react-native-paper inputs, `react-hook-form` is NOT used on mobile — keep plain controlled inputs validated with the Zod schemas): title "Sign in to Anacast"; email field; primary button "Email me a code" → validate with `otpRequestSchema` → `supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ email, options: { shouldCreateUser: <see rule> } })` → on success `router.push({ pathname: '/(auth)/verify-otp', params: { email } })`. Rule for `shouldCreateUser`: `true` when a `pending_invite_token` exists in kv (an invited person may have no account yet — DESIGN §5 "Sign in or create an account with the email address the invitation was sent to"), otherwise `false`, and the resulting Supabase error ("Signups not allowed for otp") is mapped to "No Anacast account uses this email yet. Ask your church for an invitation." Secondary link "Use a password instead" reveals a password field and swaps the button to "Sign in" → `emailPasswordSchema` → `signInWithPassword`; wrong credentials → "Email or password is incorrect" (never leak which). Link "Forgot password?" → `WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(`${publicEnv().webUrl}/auth/reset`)` (password reset stays on the web, DESIGN §5). Footer: "By signing in you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy" linking to `${webUrl}/terms` and `${webUrl}/privacy`. Disable buttons while pending; show `DomainError`/auth messages inline, never raw error objects. Rate-limit friendliness: after a successful send, disable "Email me a code" for 60 s (Supabase default OTP throttle) and say so.
4. **`(auth)/verify-otp`** (`app/(auth)/verify-otp.tsx`, `src/features/auth/OtpForm.tsx`): reads `email` from `useLocalSearchParams`; a single 6-digit numeric field (`keyboardType: 'number-pad'`, `autoComplete: 'one-time-code'`, `textContentType: 'oneTimeCode'`); auto-submits at 6 digits → `otpVerifySchema` → `supabase.auth.verifyOtp({ email, token, type: 'email' })`; on success the session provider fires and `app/index.tsx` routes on; expired/invalid → "That code is wrong or has expired" with a "Send a new code" button (60 s cooldown, same `signInWithOtp` call). Help text: "Look for an email from your church's Anacast service. The code expires in a few minutes." (the exact expiry is set by the founder in 2.4 — do not hard-code minutes). "Use a different email" → back.
5. **`(auth)/invite/[token]`** (`app/(auth)/invite/[token].tsx`, `src/features/auth/useAcceptInvitation.ts`): reached by `anacast://invite/<token>` (expo-router maps the scheme URL to this route automatically; verify with `npx uri-scheme open "anacast://invite/abc" --android` in the docs, and with a unit test of the pure parser below). Validate with `invitationTokenSchema`; malformed → friendly "This invitation link is not valid" + "Go to sign in" (never crash). Signed out → `setKv('pending_invite_token', token)` and `router.replace('/(auth)/sign-in')` with an inline notice "Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to". Signed in → call `acceptInvitation(supabase, { token })`: success → `deleteKv('pending_invite_token')`, `refreshContext()`, set active org to the returned `org_id` (Build 7's `switchOrg`), `router.replace('/(app)/(tabs)/home')`, toast "Welcome to <org name>"; `invitation_email_mismatch` → explain that the signed-in email differs, offer "Sign out and try again"; `invitation_expired`/`invitation_invalid` → message from `DOMAIN_ERROR_MESSAGES` + "Ask your church for a new invitation"; `organization_suspended` → its message. The same hook runs once from `app/index.tsx` when a session appears and `pending_invite_token` exists (the post-sign-in resume path).
6. **`(auth)/no-church`** (`app/(auth)/no-church.tsx`): "You are signed in as <email>. Your account is not linked to a church yet. Ask your church to invite you or to create your account." (DESIGN §10 wording), buttons "Check again" (`refreshContext()`), "Sign out". If any org has `membership_status === 'pending'`, add "Your request to join <name> is waiting for approval" (Phase 2 join requests, 5.6, will add join-code entry here — leave a `TODO(5.6)` comment, no UI).
7. **Active organization** `src/features/org/ActiveOrgProvider.tsx` + `useActiveOrg()`: input = `activeOrgs(ctx)`; resolution order: kv `active_org_id` if still active → `ctx.profile.last_org_id` if active → first active org (sorted by name). Exposes `{ org: { org_id, slug, name, status }, permissions, personId, householdId, orgs, switchOrg(orgId) }`. `switchOrg` sets kv, updates state, calls `setLastOrg(supabase, userId, orgId)` (fire-and-forget with error toast), invalidates every query key that is org-scoped (`queryClient.invalidateQueries()` is acceptable here). `status === 'suspended'` → render a persistent read-only banner "This church's Anacast account is suspended; content may be out of date" (reads still work — DESIGN §5 "reads stay available"). The provider is mounted in `app/(app)/_layout.tsx` only.
8. **Gate** `app/(app)/_layout.tsx`: `useSession()` + `useMyContext()`; while loading → `LoadingState`; signed out → `<Redirect href="/(auth)/sign-in" />`; no active org → `<Redirect href="/(auth)/no-church" />`; otherwise `ActiveOrgProvider` → `<Stack>` with `(tabs)` and the stack screens (`sermons/[id]`, `announcements/[id]`, `bulletins/index`, `bulletins/[id]`, `settings/notifications`) with headers titled by the org name where sensible. Use expo-router `Stack.Protected` guards if the installed `expo-router` exposes them (SDK 53+); otherwise the `Redirect` pattern above. `app/index.tsx`: the session gate — loading → splash; signed out → `/(auth)/sign-in`; signed in + pending invite → run Build 5's resume; signed in → `/(app)/(tabs)/home`. `app/(auth)/_layout.tsx`: a `Stack` with a plain header; if a signed-in user with an active org lands on an auth screen (except `invite/[token]`), redirect to home.
9. **Org switcher** `src/features/org/OrgSwitcher.tsx`: a `react-native-paper` `Modal`/bottom sheet listing `orgs` with a check on the active one; opened from a header button in the tabs (visible only when `orgs.length > 1`) and, in 4.3, from the More tab's "Switch church" row — export `useOrgSwitcher()` returning `{ open, close, canSwitch }` so 4.3 reuses it.
10. **Sign-out helper** `src/features/auth/signOut.ts`: `signOutEverywhere()` → placeholder call `await beforeSignOut()` (4.3 registers push-device deletion here — export a `registerBeforeSignOut(fn)` hook so 4.3 does not edit this file's logic), `supabase.auth.signOut()`, kv cleanup (`active_org_id`, `pending_invite_token`), `queryClient.clear()`, `router.replace('/(auth)/sign-in')`. Used by `no-church` now and by More/sign-out in 4.3.
11. **Deep-link parsing (pure, tested)** `src/lib/links.ts`: `parseAppLink(url)` → `{ kind: 'invite', token } | { kind: 'unknown' }` for `anacast://invite/<token>` and `https://<any host>/invite/<token>` (App Links arrive in 5.7 — the parser is ready now), using `invitationTokenSchema`; used by an `Linking.useURL()` effect in `app/_layout.tsx` only for the https form (expo-router already routes the scheme form). `src/lib/links.test.ts` covers both forms, a malformed token, and an unrelated URL.
12. **Tests** (Vitest, node env, mocked `supabase`): `activeOrgs`, the active-org resolution order (`src/features/org/resolveActiveOrg.ts` — keep it a pure function `resolveActiveOrg({ storedId, lastOrgId, orgs })`), `parseAppLink`, the `shouldCreateUser` rule (`src/features/auth/otpOptions.ts` → `otpOptions({ hasPendingInvite })`), and the auth error mapper (`src/features/auth/authErrors.ts`: Supabase `AuthApiError` messages → user text; `toDomainError` for RPC errors). No component tests (no jsdom for RN in this step).
13. **Copy and accessibility**: every input has `accessibilityLabel`; buttons disabled while pending with an `ActivityIndicator`; keyboard-avoiding views on both forms; email field `autoCapitalize: 'none'`, `keyboardType: 'email-address'`, `autoComplete: 'email'`.

- Supabase access only through `supabase` from `src/lib/supabase.ts`; RPCs only through `@church/db` wrappers; schemas only from `@church/domain` (`git grep -n "z.object" apps/mobile/src` must stay empty). Never hand-roll `anacast://` strings — use `APP_SCHEME`/`inviteDeepLink`. No elevated key, no `auth.admin.*`.

- Do not build the feed, players, push registration, notification settings or the More tab content (4.2a/4.2b/4.3). Do not add join-code UI (5.6). Do not change `apps/web`, shared packages (additive exports only if truly missing — record them), migrations (never `supabase db push`).

## Goal
When you finish, a member who signs in on Android (4.1b) lands on a Home tab that shows their church's pinned and recent announcements and the current bulletin, can open any announcement, can browse the bulletin archive from the stack route `bulletins/index` (linked from Home now and from the More tab in 4.3), and can open a bulletin file: PDFs download to the app cache and open in the phone's PDF viewer through an Android intent; JPG/PNG bulletins display inline. The `useSignedUrl` hook created here is the single way the app turns a `storage_path` into a playable/downloadable URL (1 h signed URL, 50 min cache, never persisted to disk, re-mint on 403 or expiry) and is reused by 4.2b's sermon players. Content is read-only; everything is scoped to the active org from 4.1b and RLS decides what the member may see (only published rows reach a member — `publish_at <= now()` is enforced in policies, PLAN §1 item 6).

## Inputs / prior state
- 4.1a/4.1b produced the app shell: `supabase` client, `AppQueryProvider` with the kv-store persister (queries with `meta.persist === false` are not dehydrated), `useSession()`, `useActiveOrg()` → `{ org: { org_id, slug, name, status }, permissions, personId, householdId, orgs, switchOrg }`, `Screen`/`LoadingState`/`ErrorState`/`EmptyState`, `publicEnv()`, `src/theme.ts`, the tabs layout and placeholder route files `app/(app)/(tabs)/home.tsx`, `app/(app)/announcements/[id].tsx`, `app/(app)/bulletins/index.tsx`, `app/(app)/bulletins/[id].tsx`.
- `@church/db` (1.7a; every helper takes the client first): `queries/announcements.ts` — `listFeed(db, orgId, { limit })` (member query: `publish_at <= now()` and `expires_at is null or > now()`), `getAnnouncement(db, id)`; `queries/bulletins.ts` — `listBulletins(db, orgId, …)`, `getCurrentBulletin(db, orgId, todayIso)` (= `starts_on <= today <= ends_on`, published, latest first), and the bulletin row shape (`title`, `starts_on`, `ends_on`, `storage_path`, `mime_type`, `file_size_bytes`, `publish_at`, `kind`/preset if 1.2 modelled one — read `packages/db/src/database.types.ts`); `queries/settings.ts` — the org settings reader (read the file for its name; it returns `organization_settings` including `timezone`); `queries/storage.ts` — `createSignedUrl(db, bucket, path, { ttl = SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS, download? })` → `{ url, expiresAt }`; `keys.ts` — `queryKeys.announcements.list(orgId, filters)`, `.announcements.detail(id)`, `.bulletins.*`, `.settings(orgId)`; constants `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` (3600) and `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` (50 min). If `queryKeys` has no signed-URL key, add `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)` additively in `packages/db/src/keys.ts` with a one-line test and record it in HANDOFF.
- `@church/domain` (1.6a/1.6b): `dates.ts` org-timezone helpers (today in a timezone, formatting with `date-fns` + `@date-fns/tz`) — read `packages/domain/src/dates.ts` and reuse its functions for "today" and for displaying `publish_at`/`starts_on`; `limits.ts` `BUCKETS` (`bulletins` allows pdf/jpeg/png, 25 MiB); `errors.ts` `toDomainError`.
- Web 3.5a/3.5b: announcements carry `title`, `body`, `audience_group_id`, `publish_at`, `expires_at`, `pinned`, `push`; bulletins are uploaded to bucket `bulletins` at `{org_id}/bulletins/{bulletin_id}/{uuid}.{pdf,jpg,png}` (DESIGN §7) with presets "This Sunday" / "Quarter" that only set `starts_on`/`ends_on`. Founder decision 6: push on bulletin upload is on by default — irrelevant to rendering, but the Home card must show the CURRENT bulletin by date range, not the latest upload.
- Storage RLS: `storage.objects` select policies (1.4a) let an active member sign URLs for their org's `bulletins` and `sermon-media` objects; the client never proxies bytes through the web app.

## Build
1. **`src/lib/signed-url.ts`** — `useSignedUrl(bucket: BucketId, path: string | null, opts?: { download?: string })`: `useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path), queryFn: () => createSignedUrl(supabase, bucket, path, { ttl: SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS, download }), enabled: !!path, staleTime: SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS, gcTime: SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS, meta: { persist: false }, retry: 1 })` returning `{ url, expiresAt, isExpired, remint }` where `remint = () => queryClient.fetchQuery(…, { staleTime: 0 })` and `isExpired` compares `expiresAt` with `Date.now()`. Also export a non-hook `getSignedUrl(bucket, path)` (`queryClient.ensureQueryData` + expiry check) for imperative flows (PDF download). Contract comment: "never persisted (DESIGN §10); players call `remint()` on HTTP 403 / playback error, then retry once". Unit-test the pure `isSignedUrlExpired(expiresAt, now)` and the query-key shape.
2. **Feed data** `src/features/feed/useFeed.ts`: `useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.announcements.list(orgId, { feed: true }), queryFn: () => listFeed(supabase, orgId, { limit: 50 }) })`; pure `sortFeed(rows)` = pinned first (`pinned desc`), then `publish_at desc` (tested); `useCurrentBulletin.ts`: read settings for `timezone` (`queryKeys.settings(orgId)`; fall back to `America/New_York`, the plan default, when missing), compute `todayIso` with the `@church/domain` date helper in that timezone, then `getCurrentBulletin(supabase, orgId, todayIso)`.
3. **Home** `app/(app)/(tabs)/home.tsx` + `src/features/feed/{AnnouncementCard,BulletinCard,FeedList}.tsx`: header with the org name and (when `orgs.length > 1`) the switcher button from 4.1b; a `FlatList` with `RefreshControl` (pull-to-refresh invalidates feed + current bulletin); list header = `BulletinCard` for the current bulletin ("This week's bulletin" / for a quarterly range "Bulletin: <start> – <end>"; tap → `bulletins/[id]`; "See all bulletins" link → `bulletins/index`; hidden entirely when none); items = `AnnouncementCard` (pin icon when `pinned`, title, first ~160 chars of body, relative date via the domain date helpers, "Expires <date>" when `expires_at` is set); empty state "No announcements yet"; error state with Retry; when the query is served from the persisted cache and the refetch fails, keep showing cached rows with a subtle "Showing saved content — you appear to be offline" bar (use `@tanstack/react-query`'s `isPaused`/`fetchStatus` + `onlineManager`; wire `onlineManager` to `@react-native-community/netinfo` ONLY if 4.1a installed it — otherwise rely on fetch failures; do not add native packages in this step).
4. **Announcement detail** `app/(app)/announcements/[id].tsx` + `src/features/feed/AnnouncementDetail.tsx`: `getAnnouncement(supabase, id)` with `queryKeys.announcements.detail(id)`, `initialData` from the feed cache when present; renders title, published date, pinned badge, full `body` as plain text with selectable text and auto-linked URLs (`Linking.openURL` via a small `LinkifiedText` — do NOT add a markdown library); a linked document (Phase 2, 5.4) is not rendered — leave a `TODO(5.4)` comment; 404/RLS-hidden → "This announcement is no longer available". This route is the target of push taps in 4.3 (`/announcements/<id>`), so it must work when opened cold with only an id.
5. **Bulletins list** `app/(app)/bulletins/index.tsx` + `src/features/bulletins/BulletinList.tsx`: `listBulletins(supabase, orgId, …)` published only (RLS already filters; pass `drafts: false` or the equivalent if the helper has the option), newest `starts_on` first, grouped visually by month; each row shows title, date range, file kind icon (pdf/image), size; tap → `bulletins/[id]`. Pull-to-refresh, empty state "Your church has not posted a bulletin yet".
6. **Bulletin detail + open** `app/(app)/bulletins/[id].tsx` + `src/features/bulletins/BulletinDetail.tsx` + `src/features/bulletins/OpenPdf.ts` (name fixed by DESIGN §11 step 10): shows title, range, size, and a primary button "Open bulletin". `openBulletinFile({ bucket: 'bulletins', path, mimeType, fileName })`: (a) `getSignedUrl('bulletins', path)`; (b) download with the `expo-file-system` API installed by 4.1a — prefer the SDK 54+ object API (`new File(Paths.cache, fileName)` / `File.downloadFileAsync(url, destination)`), else the legacy `downloadAsync`; overwrite an existing cached file; (c) Android: `FileSystem.getContentUriAsync(localUri)` (or the `File` equivalent) then `IntentLauncher.startActivityAsync('android.intent.action.VIEW', { data: contentUri, flags: 1 /* FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION */, type: mimeType })`; when no activity can handle it (`ActivityNotFoundException`) → toast "No PDF viewer is installed. Opening in the browser instead." and `WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(signedUrl)`; (d) iOS (untested until Phase 3, DESIGN §7 "iOS renders natively"): `expo-sharing` `shareAsync(localUri)` or `WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(signedUrl)` — pick one, comment it `Phase 3 (6.4) verifies`. Images (`image/jpeg`, `image/png`): render inline with `expo-image` (`contentFit: 'contain'`, pinch-zoom not required) plus a "Share" button using `expo-sharing`. Show a progress indicator during download (files are ≤ 25 MiB, `BUCKETS.bulletins`); on 403/expired → `remint()` once and retry, then a friendly error. Files stay in `cacheDirectory` (OS may purge); delete the previous file for the same bulletin before downloading a new one.
7. **Analytics of nothing**: no tracking. **Accessibility**: cards are `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"` and labels; text sizes respect the system font scale.
8. **Tests** (Vitest, node): `sortFeed`, `isSignedUrlExpired`, `bulletinRangeLabel(starts_on, ends_on)` (one Sunday → "Sunday, <date>"; longer range → "<start> – <end>"), `pickOpener(mimeType, platform)` → `'intent' | 'inline_image' | 'share' | 'browser'`, and the `LinkifiedText` URL splitter. Mock `@church/db` queries and `expo-*` modules in tests (`vi.mock`), no jsdom.
9. **Docs**: add a "Mobile playback and files" section to `apps/mobile/README.md` (signed URL lifetime, cache, PDF intent) — `docs/MEDIA.md` itself is written in 4.4.

## Constraints
- Reads only through `@church/db` queries with the user client from `src/lib/supabase.ts`; never `supabase.from(...)` directly in screens; never the base directory tables (Phase 2 rule — irrelevant now but do not add directory reads). No new Zod schemas in the app.
- Signed URLs: `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` and `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` from `@church/db` only; `meta: { persist: false }` on every signed-URL query; never store a signed URL in kv or in a persisted query.
- Native dependency versions only via `npx expo install`; do not add packages beyond those 4.1a installed (`expo-file-system`, `expo-intent-launcher`, `expo-sharing`, `expo-image`, `expo-web-browser` are already there). No `react-native-pdf`, no `expo-av`.
- Do not build the Sermons tab, `sermons/[id]`, the players (4.2b), push, More-tab rows or notification settings (4.3). Do not touch `apps/web`, migrations (never `supabase db push`), or the shared packages except the additive `queryKeys.signedUrl` if missing.
- No secrets; no model identifiers in commits or files.
